messages:
anya: Quick thread — sketching a Console UX and runtime semantics for per-route redaction PRESETS + how they should affect sampling and quota math. Pasting a minimal config and a few questions. feedback pls.

sam: nice. do you mean presets like 'max-redact' vs 'allow-debug' that ops can toggle per-route?

anya: yeah — presets are named bundles of redaction + sampling defaults. idea is to let customers pick a preset on a route instead of configuring ten toggles. e.g. admin endpoints use 'max-redact', public SDKs use 'dev-debug'.

kevin: curious about implications for usage billing and quota enforcement. if we strip PII from payloads, do we still count tokens the same? customers will ask.

anya: proposal: tokens are counted against request/response after redaction for billing and quota. reason: reduces surprises (if we drop large attachments they shouldn't count). but we need to be transparent in Console so folks don't think traffic magically vanished.

sam: agreed on transparency. console should show pre/post token estimate and a small histogram of redaction savings. also need to show sample-rate applied when route is 'ephemeral-debug'.

anya: example minimal preset draft: 
```yaml
presets:
  max-redact:
    remove_pii: true
    mask_fields: [email, ssn, phone]
    inline_truncate: 256
    preserve_kv_cache: false

  dev-debug:
    remove_pii: false
    sample_rate: 0.02
    preserve_kv_cache: true

routes:
  /v1/generate:
    preset: max-redact
    quota: {monthly_tokens: 5000000}

  /v1/debug/interactive:
    preset: dev-debug
    quota: {monthly_tokens: 200000}
```

kevin: small nit: preserve_kv_cache false on max-redact could increase latency for repeated prompts — ok tradeoff, but should be explicit in Console tooltip. also we need to decide whether sampled captures (1 in N) are stored in audit logs unredacted for legal teams.

anya: on sampled captures: suggest sampled audit copies are still redacted if the route's preset is max-redact. for requests with legal hold they can opt-in to an "exempt-audit" route that requires DSR & auditing approvals.

devon: ops-bot: can we run an experiment pipeline mapping preset -> observable signals? need metrics: token_savings_pct, avg_latency_ms, sample_capture_ratio, quota_burn_rate.

ops-bot: @devon queued metric job: preset-observability-2024-06. will report to #telemetry-daily.

sam: UX questions: 
- How do we represent mixed-mode routes (preset + per-tenant overrides)?
- Should preset changes be versioned with rollout (canary) and diff preview in Console?

anya: answers: 
- allow tenants to opt into stricter preset or inherit. display inheritance chain in Console.
- yep — every preset change becomes a rollout artifact; Console shows a preview diff (pre/post token estimate + sample capture change). Canary rollout for 1%/10%/100%.

kevin: implementation question: do we evaluate redaction before routing and sampling decisions or after? e.g., routing by tenant tier might depend on unredacted metadata (email domain) — need ordering.

anya: ordering proposal: 1) minimal routing headers (tenant id, route id) decide routing 2) redaction applied to body/attachments 3) sampling decision (for audit capture) uses redaction-masked payload unless sampling policy explicitly opts into raw-inspect (requires legal approval).

sam: that ordering maps to privacy-first principle. just flagging that it will break some legacy heuristics that relied on raw content for dynamic routing. we should provide a migration guide.

kevin: last point — quota math: if sample_rate < 1, do we bill tokens for sampled copies? i.e., if we capture an extra redacted copy for auditing, double-count?

anya: billing rule: charge for tokens in the authoritative request/response path only. audit/store copies are metered separately under 'audit storage units' (not customer tokens) so billing is transparent. We'll add a billing FAQ in Console.

sam: action items:
- anya: draft Console mockups (preset list, inheritance UI, diff preview) by EOD Fri
- kevin: spec telemetry metrics and quota/billing FAQ by Mon
- devon: experiment job config to compute token_savings_pct for three routes by Thu

anya: thanks. cc @ops-bot for rollout playbook — we should include a 'revert preset' quick action. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: noted: rollout playbook checklist will include canary, quota gate, revert action, legal review link.

kevin: one more: include a tiny line in Console that says "redaction may affect downstream model behavior" — for customer expectations.

anya: good call, will add.

sam: ok let's sync Wed 10am to review mocks + metrics.

kevin: 👍

devon: have a quick draft on the experiment infra, will post results as soon as job completes.

anya: closing thread — thanks all.
